content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Non-Payment
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you have failed to pay the rent for the month of July, 2024, in the amount of $1,000.00, as required under your lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Action_to_Be_Taken
content_blocks.text: If you do not vacate the premises within thirty (30) days from the date of this notice, you will be considered in default of your lease and may be subject to legal action for eviction.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Legal_Action
content_blocks.text: In the event of non-compliance, the landlord reserves the right to file an action for eviction in the appropriate court.
